summary:
Main
• Capesize Spot Index Stabilizes but Risk Remain Abound - The recent correction in Capesize spot rates appears to have established a floor, with the index stabilizing just below the 30,000 mark after a peak-to-trough decline of over 50%. While freight futures initially tracked this downward movement, front-month contracts are now trading at a premium to the spot index, signaling an anticipated revival in market activity and thus a potential increase in freight rates. This optimism aligns with historical seasonal strength over the next two months, which typically drives rates to annual peaks.
